resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing from nonmagical attacks

attacks.name: Bel's Vengence
attacks.notes: +1d8 slashing, +1d6 fire, 1 charge. Heavy, Reach, Two-Handed, Graze. GWF rerolls 1-2

attacks.name: Chill Touch
attacks.notes: No healing until your next turn

resources.name: Bel's Vengence charges
resources.notes: Max not on sheet. Wall of Fire uses a charge

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Action Surge
features.text: On your turn, you can take one additional action. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

features.name: Second Wind
features.text: On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + 6 (your fighter level). Once used, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

features.name: Great Weapon Fighting
features.text: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property.

features.name: Weapon Bond
features.text: Through a 1-hour ritual you bond with up to two weapons. You can't be disarmed of a bonded weapon unless you are incapacitated, and if it is on the same plane you can summon it to your hand as a bonus action.

features.name: Spellcasting (Eldritch Knight)
features.text: You cast wizard spells using Intelligence. Spell save DC 11, spell attack +3. You regain expended slots on a long rest.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.text: You cast warlock spells using Charisma. Spell save DC 14, spell attack +6. You can use an arcane focus. Your pact slot returns on a short or long rest.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.text: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + your warlock level (4).

features.name: Polearm Master: Bonus Attack
features.text: When you take the Attack action with only a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff or spear, you can use a bonus action to make a melee attack with the opposite end of the weapon. It uses the same ability modifier as the primary attack and deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Polearm Master: Opportunity Attack
features.text: While you are wielding a glaive, halberd, pike, quarterstaff or spear, other creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they enter your reach.

features.name: Devil's Tongue
features.text: You know the vicious mockery cantrip. You can cast charm person (as a 2nd-level spell) once per long rest, and enthrall once per long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these (DC 14).

features.name: Hellish Resistance
features.text: You have resistance to fire damage.

features.name: Darkvision
features.text: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (shades of grey only).

actions.name: Polearm Master butt end
actions.text: After taking the Attack action with Bel's Vengence, make a bonus-action attack with the opposite end: +8 to hit, 1d4+5 bludgeoning.

actions.name: Wall of Fire
actions.text: Spend 1 charge to cast Wall of Fire (4th level, DEX save DC 15, concentration up to 1 minute).

actions.name: Infernal edge
actions.text: Sheet notes for this weapon: +1d8 slashing, +1d6 fire, 1 charge. Graze mastery: on a miss, deal damage equal to your Strength modifier. Edit this with the item's real wording.

proficiencies.weapons: Simple, hand crossbow, longbow, longsword, rapier, shortsword
proficiencies.tools: Disguise kit, Poisoner's kit, Thieves' tools

features.name: Sneak Attack (4d6)
features.text: Once per turn, you can deal an extra 4d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage on the attack roll. The attack must use a finesse or ranged weapon. You don't need advantage if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it, that enemy isn't incapacitated, and you don't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.text: You can take a bonus action on each of your turns to take the Dash, Disengage or Hide action.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.text: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

features.name: Evasion
features.text: When you are subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

features.name: Expertise
features.text: Your proficiency bonus is doubled for ability checks with your chosen proficiencies (Athletics, Perception, Stealth, and one more on the sheet).

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.text: You know thieves' cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon and code for hiding messages in seemingly normal conversation. It takes four times longer to convey such a message than to speak the idea plainly.

features.name: Spellcasting (Arcane Trickster)
features.text: You cast wizard spells using Intelligence. Spell save DC 13, spell attack +5.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.text: When you cast mage hand, you can make the spectral hand invisible, and use it to stow or retrieve objects or use thieves' tools to pick locks and disarm traps at range. You can disguise this with a Sleight of Hand check, and control the hand with your Cunning Action bonus action.

features.name: Crossbow Expert
features.text: You ignore the loading property of crossbows you are proficient with. Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls. When you use the Attack action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to attack with a hand crossbow you are holding.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.text: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

features.name: Trance
features.text: You don't need to sleep. Instead you meditate semiconsciously for 4 hours a day, gaining the same benefit a human does from 8 hours of sleep.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.text: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

features.name: Darkvision
features.text: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (shades of grey only).

proficiencies.tools: Disguise kit, Dulcimer, Fiddle, Hand drum, Lute

resources.name: Bardic Inspiration
resources.notes: Bonus action, 60 ft, 1d8. Font of Inspiration

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d8)
features.text: As a bonus action, choose one creature other than yourself within 60 feet who can hear you. It gains an inspiration die (d8). Within the next 10 minutes it can add the die to one ability check, attack roll or saving throw, after seeing the roll but before knowing the outcome. Font of Inspiration: you regain all uses on a short or long rest.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.text: A creature that has one of your Bardic Inspiration dice can roll it and add it to a weapon damage roll it just made. Or, when an attack roll is made against it, it can use its reaction to roll the die and add it to its AC against that attack, after seeing the roll but before knowing whether it hits.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Countercharm
features.text: As an action, you start a performance that lasts until the end of your next turn. During that time, you and any friendly creatures within 30 feet who can hear you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed.

features.name: Song of Rest (d6)
features.text: If you or any friendly creatures who can hear your performance regain hit points at the end of a short rest by spending Hit Dice, each of those creatures regains an extra 1d6 hit points.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.text: You can add half your proficiency bonus (+1), rounded down, to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: You cast bard spells using Charisma. Spell save DC 15, spell attack +7. You can cast known bard spells as rituals if they have the ritual tag, and use a musical instrument as a focus.

features.name: Lucky
features.text: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

features.name: Brave
features.text: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

features.name: Halfling Nimbleness
features.text: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

features.name: Naturally Stealthy
features.text: You can attempt to hide even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

features.name: Actor
features.text: You have advantage on Deception and Performance checks when trying to pass yourself off as a different person, and you can mimic the speech of another person or the sounds made by other creatures you have heard for at least 1 minute.

attacks.name: Torm's Blessing
attacks.notes: Versatile, Push. Can cast Sacred Flame

resources.name: Channel Divinity
resources.notes: Turn Undead / Preserve Life (35 HP split, up to half max)

spells.name: Glyph of Warding
spells.notes: Special: Spell Glyph (See Description)*, D: Until Dispelled or Triggered, V/S/M

features.name: Channel Divinity (2 / short rest)
features.text: You can channel divine energy directly from your deity to fuel magical effects: Turn Undead or Preserve Life. You have two uses, and regain them when you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn Undead
features.text: As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer censuring the undead. Each undead within 30 feet that can see or hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15). On a failure it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage: it must spend its turns moving as far from you as it can and can't willingly move within 30 feet of you. Destroy Undead: undead of CR 1/2 or lower that fail are destroyed instead.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
features.text: As an action, you evoke healing energy that restores 35 hit points (five times your cleric level), divided as you choose among any creatures within 30 feet. It can't restore a creature to more than half its hit point maximum, and has no effect on undead or constructs.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.text: Whenever you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore hit points to a creature, the creature regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.text: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that restores hit points to a creature other than you, you regain hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 1/2)
features.text: When an undead fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, it is instantly destroyed if its challenge rating is 1/2 or lower.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: You prepare cleric spells using Wisdom (Wisdom modifier + cleric level = 11, plus domain spells). Spell save DC 15, spell attack +7. You can cast prepared spells as rituals if they have the ritual tag, and use a holy symbol as a focus.

features.name: Dwarven Resilience
features.text: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance against poison damage.

features.name: Dwarven Toughness
features.text: Your hit point maximum increases by 1 for every level (already included).

features.name: Stonecunning
features.text: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient and add double your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Observant
features.text: If you can see a creature's mouth while it is speaking a language you understand, you can read its lips. You have a +5 bonus to passive Perception and passive Investigation (already included).

features.name: Darkvision
features.text: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (the sheet shows 90 ft, so something extends it).

actions.name: Sacred Flame
actions.text: Cast Sacred Flame through the hammer: DEX save DC 15, 60 ft, 2d8 radiant at this level.

actions.name: Push
actions.text: Push mastery: when you hit with the hammer, you can push a Large or smaller target up to 10 feet straight away from you.
